intent: The span inside a QuestionnaireChoice row that holds the answer text and stacks a QuestionnaireChoiceDescription under it.
typical_uses: The text span a QuestionnaireChoice renders around its children

invariants.text: QuestionnaireChoice renders one QuestionnaireChoiceLabel around its own children and is the only provider of the context this part needs, so a consumer-placed one always nests inside that built-in label.

anti_patterns.dont: Wrap a choice's text in QuestionnaireChoiceLabel
anti_patterns.do_instead: Pass the text straight to QuestionnaireChoice, which already wraps it in this span

render.states: render replaces the rendered element with one the caller supplies
render.because: The questionnaire engine's render prop takes an element or a function of the label's state (an empty state object for this part), so its type is a union of a React element and a callback; the compiler emits one JSON type per property, so nothing is asserted.

good.title: The text span comes with the choice

bad.title: The text wrapped a second time
bad.why: The choice already wraps its children in this span; the nested one is a label span inside a label span and takes a second copy of its flex layout.

render.description: TS: RenderProp<RenderState> | undefined. The compiler emits one JSON type per property; this type is left to tsc. render replaces the rendered element with one the caller supplies.
